title: What Do LLMs Associate with Your Name? A Human-Centered Black-Box Audit of Personal Data

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing LLM associations using name-based fragment completion prompts to identify 'default token collapse,' where models systematically default to predicting 'male' when lacking specific memorized information about an individual.
Evaluating LLM outputs for 'sexual orientation' using name-based prompts to detect biased default predictions, such as models systematically outputting 'bisexual' as a base-rate guess.

Comparing user-reported accuracy and model confidence for majority versus minority physical characteristics (e.g., brown vs. blue eyes, blonde hair, ambidextrous handedness) to evaluate whether models rely on naive majority-class predictions or base-rate anchoring.
